annotation_method: Source inspection before running Semweft or SCIP on these projections. Convenience sample of 10 local declaration bindings per repository, plus parameter-call uncertainty in pflag and trace-mapping. Source review distinguishes direct/static dispatch from five TypeScript virtual-method declaration bindings; virtual bindings are measured separately and must not become definite runtime calls. One sort-call text anchor was corrected after checking its source coordinate. Authored by Codex; no independent human audit, random sampling, or population-wide confidence claim. Targets come from source declarations, not producer output. JavaScript additions cover clsx, mri and all four klona source variants: 28 local helper/recursive calls and two input-supplied callback/constructor cases, labelled from source before indexing these projects.
